[EN] You made dragon on a stick for Pond Faire.
[ES] Hiciste un dragón en brocheta para la Pond Faire.

[EN] Tuwangi hungry. Must eat dragon!
, you kill, you grill, and we share! Talk about the short end of the stick.
[ES] Tuwangi hambriento. ¡Debemos comer dragón!
, tú matas, tú asas, ¡y compartimos! Talk about the short end of the stick.

[EN] Dragon make tuwangi fierce and strong. Best food for tuwangis. Uh, dragons are... oh, never mind.
[ES] El dragón hace que los tuwangis sean feroces y fuertes. La mejor comida para los tuwangis. Uh, dragons are... oh, never mind.
